title: External personnel screening and provider notification need sponsor evidence
remediation: The sponsor procurement and personnel security officials document external personnel screening, provider obligations, government oversight and end-user responsibilities, notification recipients and deadlines for transfers or terminations. Sample sponsor oversight and a timely credential or privilege change under the applicable agreement. Record provider scope and submit inheritance decisions for review.

milestones.title: Collect approved external personnel obligations and a redacted screening, notification or access change and provider oversight sample
